log.msg: Read brief, vision-direction/quality.md + task.jsonl, vision readme, run.mjs, css-v3, critique-full-v4, probe.js. DECISION on --from: NOT built. Turn 2 resumes turn 1's SESSION (second() passes rec.session_id), and those sessions already contain the vision-direction css-v3 answer - resuming or forking them shows the model its own prior CSS. A --from that re-injects findings into a fresh session is a different experiment (one turn, no turn-1 prose). So turn 1 runs again at $0.71, exactly as the brief allows: same pngs, same prompt, same model, the ONLY changed variable is that turn 2 now sees measurements. SHEETS FIX: document.styleSheets is useless for narrowing - every page loads the same ~70 sheets (probed all 6 urls headless). Real fix is to ask which sheets carry a rule that MATCHES the finding's node (el.matches(rule.selectorText) over cssRules, recursing @layer/@media) - that is literally the css that cascades, and on /framework/ai/ it finds ext/AITask/ai.css.
